slides.title: Buying a Laval condo? Check these 5 things first.
slides.sub: The building's paperwork tells you more than the showing does.

photo.credit: Boulevard René-Laennec, Laval · Photo: Veillg1, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Know the price by sector
slides.body: Chomedey condos took **59 days** on average to sell. Use that time to read the building's papers.

slides.title: Ask for the syndicate certificate
slides.body: Since Aug. 14, 2025, the seller must give it to you. The syndicate has **15 days** to issue it.

slides.title: Read the contingency fund study
slides.body: It shows if the building is saving enough for future repairs. Syndicates generally have until 2028 for the first one.

slides.title: Look at the maintenance log
slides.body: It lists the building's parts, their condition and big repairs ahead. Compare it with the fund study.

slides.title: Read the by-laws and minutes
slides.body: By-laws can limit pets or balcony barbecues. Minutes can show changes being discussed. Your notary can walk you through them.
